description.zh:
经典网络连接地址的保留时间，取值：**14**、**30**、**60**、**120**，单位为天。

> * 当**RetainClassic**取值为**True**，本参数才可用且必须传入。
> * 完成切换后，您还可以调用[ModifyInstanceNetExpireTime](~~473793~~)修改经典网络连接地址的保留时间。
description.en:
The retention period of the classic network endpoint. Valid values: **14**, **30**, **60**, and **120**. Unit: days.

> 

*   This parameter is available and required only when the **RetainClassic** parameter is set to **True**.

*   After you complete the switchover operation, you can also call the [ModifyInstanceNetExpireTime](~~473793~~) operation to modify the retention period of the classic network endpoint.
The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~473778~~) operation to query the ID of the instance.

description.zh:
如果实例当前为经典网络，将其切换至专有网络时，是否保留原经典网络连接地址，取值：
* **True**：保留。
* **False**：默认值，不保留。

> 当实例的网络类型为经典网络时，本参数才可用。
description.en:
Specifies whether to retain the original classic network endpoint after you switch the instance from classic network to VPC. Default value: False. Valid values:

*   **True**: retains the classic network endpoint.
*   **False**: does not retain the classic network endpoint.

> This parameter is available only when the network type of the instance is classic network.

description.zh: 需要切换到的网络类型，取值固定为**VPC**，即专有网络。
description.en: The network type to which you want to switch. If you want to switch to VPC network, Set the value to **VPC**.

description.zh:
要切换到的目标专有网络下的虚拟交换机ID，可调用专有网络VPC的[DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~)获取。
> 目标虚拟交换机所属的可用区需和本实例相同。
description.en:
The ID of the vSwitch that belongs to the VPC to which you want to switch. You can call the [DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~) operation to query the vSwitch ID.

>  The vSwitch and the instance must be deployed in the same zone.

description.zh:
要切换到的目标专有网络ID，可调用专有网络VPC的[DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~)获取。

> * 目标专有网络所属的地域需和本实例相同。
> * 传入本参数后，您还需要传入**VSwitchId**参数。
description.en:
The ID of the VPC to which you want to switch. You can call the [DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~) operation to query the VPC ID.

> 

*   The VPC and the instance must be deployed in the same region.

*   After you set this parameter, you must also set the **VSwitchId** parameter.

title.zh: 切换专有网络VPC或交换机

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore switch-network --target-network-type VPC --vpc-id vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000 --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --retain-classic True --classic-expired-days 30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore SwitchNetwork --region cn-hangzhou --RetainClassic True --VpcId 'vpc-bp1nme44gek34slfc0000' --ClassicExpiredDays 30 --TargetNetworkType VPC --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --VSwitchId 'vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000'
